plugins.name: skysynth
plugins.description: /skysynth: coding agents build a system specialized for your workload, checked by tests or machine-checked proofs. Includes the /skysynth skill, the agent roles, and the hook that runs the tests before anything is delivered. Also install the skydiscover Python package: uv pip install git+https://github.com/skydiscover-ai/skydiscover (or run from a source checkout).

description: SkyDiscover plugins for Claude Code. SkySynth builds a system specialized for your workload, hardware, and requirements, and checks it with tests or proofs.
